The crystal is described in space group Imma, number 74, with Hall symbol -I 2b 2. The original input cell is orthorhombic, with lattice parameters a = 6.03 Å, b = 6.13 Å, c = 8.45 Å, and angles α = β = γ = 90.0°. The input cell contains 32 atoms with composition Li₈Ni₄O₁₆V₄. The frame transformation from the input to the standard setting is the identity matrix with zero origin shift, so the input and standard coordinate frames coincide.

The structure is described by six independent Wyckoff orbits. Four of these are fixed-position orbits with no free parameters: lithium occupies the 4b site at (0, 0, 1/2) and the 4d site at (1/4, 1/4, 3/4); vanadium occupies the 4c site at (1/4, 1/4, 1/4); and nickel occupies the 4a site at (0, 0, 0). These four orbits each have multiplicity 4.

The two oxygen orbits have free positional parameters. The first oxygen orbit, 8i, has coordinate relation (x, 1/4, z) with free parameters x = 0.237 and z = 0.9950000000000001. The second oxygen orbit, 8h, has coordinate relation (0, y, z) with free parameters y = 0.02699999999999997 and z = 0.76. Both oxygen orbits have multiplicity 8.

No precision corrections are applied; the reported values represent the idealized backbone positions. The input fractional coordinates were rounded to 3 decimal places.
